entry: Move the Ink, Don't Redraw It
path: Move the Ink, Don't Redraw It.md
claim: Why redrawing fails: warping one inked still is exact and loops seamlessly (frame N = frame 0), while per-frame AI restyle 'boils' — measured 0.15/255 vs 1.50/255 frame-to-frame change. Boil is something you see, not read.

pieces.what: Two loops side by side on the same smoke, warp vs per-frame restyle, with a live frame-difference meter under each so the 10x gap is read off the motion itself; opens on one still frame, then one warp, then the loop closing on frame 0
A displacement field you can push from ripple to billow until topology has to change; the piece shows where warped ink tears and a redraw earns itself
pieces.walks_up_from: one displacement vector moving one pixel of ink

pieces.what: BLUELINE M3 seed-lock vs per-step warp sequences laid as a pair — the same lesson twice
